notes.title: The Seven Stages Launched!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
       I'd like to take a moment to introduce myself.  My name is Weston Bell-Geddes.  I'm a highschool VR developer located in Southern California that has hosted a booth at VRLA and published five virtual reality games.  You can read more about me and what I do on my [url=https://www.westonbdev.com/] website	[/url].  As this is my first "big" publication I look forward to the revison process with the players.  If you have the time, please tell me your thoughts, areas of improvment for the game and how I can make you more comfortable playing my game.  If you have any questions, concerns or complaints please feel free to reach out via my personal [url=mailto:westonbdev@gmail.com] email	[/url].  As I've said, [i] The Seven Stages	[/i] is not for everyone.  As it requires critical thinking, problem solving skills and patience.  Each puzzle is crafted with precision and difficulty in mind.  Thank you to those who take the time to help me truly better my game.  I look forward to working with you all.

Bests,
Weston Bell-Geddes
